attributes.action: Prison time and life ban from owning any animal when convicted of animal abuse
attributes.background: Anyone convicted of animal abuse to serve time in prison and be banned from owning any animal for the rest of their life

rejection.details:
We do have two petitions currently open which ask for the same thing as your petition is requesting. You may wish to sign them:

Introduce lifetime bans for all animal abusers and DBS checks for pet sitters
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/767555

Require immediate custodial sentences for animal abuse, cruelty & neglect
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/775033
